products.name: BitLocker Drive Encryption — Commercial
products.short_description: Silently encrypt every drive and escrow keys to Entra. Deploy BitLocker yourself with self-guided, tested steps — for a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Fleet-wide full-disk encryption with escrowed recovery keys

A laptop left in a taxi is only a breach if its drive is readable. BitLocker encrypts the whole disk so a lost or stolen device exposes nothing — and managed through Intune it turns on silently on TPM devices, with every recovery key escrowed to Microsoft Entra ID so your help desk can always recover access.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy BitLocker Drive Encryption. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Intune-managed BitLocker works, silently, with key escrow.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (edition, TPM, UEFI, Entra) with verify/implement steps.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered Intune disk-encryption steps (XTS-AES 256, OS + fixed drives, escrow-before-enable).
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — readiness discovery, encryption validation, tenant reporting, safe remediation, and recovery-key retrieval.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every drive encrypted to XTS-AES 256, enabled with no user friction, and every recovery key safely escrowed — device-loss data protection and a compliance cornerstone, with the recovery process documented for your help desk.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • BITLK-Discovery.ps1 — BitLocker readiness check
    • BITLK-Get-RecoveryKey.ps1 — retrieve a device's BitLocker recovery key from Entra ID (Graph)
    • BITLK-Remediation.ps1 — safe BitLocker remediation: ensure a recovery protector, escrow it, resume protection
    • BITLK-TenantReport.ps1 — tenant-wide BitLocker encryption status report (Microsoft Graph)
    • BITLK-Validation.ps1 — confirm the OS drive is properly encrypted and has a recovery protector

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
